lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Camping. Peppa and her family are going camping. I love camping!
lines.zh: 露营。佩奇一家要去露营。我喜欢露营！

lines.en: We're here! Peppa, George, this is the tent I had when I was a little boy. Daddy, how are you going to make that into a tent?
lines.zh: 我们到啦！佩奇，乔治，这是我小时候用过的帐篷。爸爸，你要怎么把它搭成帐篷呢？

lines.en: Don't worry, Peppa, I'm an expert at camping. Mummy Pig, put the tent on the poles, please. That's it, easy as pie.
lines.zh: 别担心，佩奇，我可是露营专家。猪妈妈，请把帐篷套到杆子上。就这样，小菜一碟。

lines.en: Oh, do these pegs do anything? Of course, I forgot about the pegs. The pegs hold the tent up.
lines.zh: 哦，这些地钉有什么用吗？当然有用，我把地钉给忘了。地钉能把帐篷固定住。

lines.en: There! The tent is a bit little. It was big enough for me when I was a boy, but it does look a bit small now. That's because you've grown a bit since you were a boy, Daddy Pig. And your tummy has grown the most of all!
lines.zh: 好了！帐篷有点小。我小时候用它刚刚好，可现在看起来确实有点小了。那是因为猪爸爸你长大了不少呀。而且你的肚子长得最多！

lines.en: Talking of tummies, we should cook supper. Yes, yes! First, we have to collect sticks to make a fire. Yes!
lines.zh: 说到肚子，我们该做晚饭了。对，对！首先，我们得捡些树枝生火。好耶！

lines.en: Peppa and George are helping Daddy Pig collect sticks for the campfire. George, I'll pick up the sticks, and you can carry them. Collecting sticks is fun!
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治在帮猪爸爸捡树枝生篝火。乔治，我来捡树枝，你来搬。捡树枝真好玩！

lines.en: Good, that's enough sticks. That's a splendid campfire. Now I'll light it.
lines.zh: 好了，树枝够了。这堆篝火真棒。现在我来把它点着。

lines.en: Here are the matches. We don't need matches.
lines.zh: 火柴在这儿。我们不需要火柴。

lines.en: Daddy, how can you light it without matches? I'm going to make fire the old way, by simply rubbing these two sticks together.
lines.zh: 爸爸，没有火柴你怎么点火？我要用最老的办法生火，就是把这两根树枝互相摩擦。

lines.en: Daddy Pig is rubbing the two sticks together to light the campfire. Where is the fire, Daddy? Nearly there. Whoa! Easy as pie!
lines.zh: 猪爸爸正在把两根树枝互相摩擦，想点燃篝火。爸爸，火在哪儿呢？快好了。哇哦！小菜一碟！

lines.en: Now we can heat up the tomato soup. Ah, listen to the sounds of nature.
lines.zh: 现在我们可以热番茄汤了。啊，听听大自然的声音。

lines.en: What is that sound? That is the sound of crickets chirping.
lines.zh: 那是什么声音？那是蟋蟀的叫声。

lines.en: What is that? That's an owl. Look, there it is! Wow!
lines.zh: 那是什么？那是一只猫头鹰。看，它就在那儿！哇！

lines.en: And what's that noise? Oh, I'm not sure. It's Daddy's tummy!
lines.zh: 那那是什么声音？哦，我不太确定。是爸爸的肚子在叫！

lines.en: My tummy rumbling is one of the best sounds of nature. It means it's time to eat! I love tomato soup. So do I!
lines.zh: 我的肚子咕咕叫是大自然最美妙的声音之一。它意味着该吃饭啦！我喜欢番茄汤。我也是！

lines.en: There's another one of Daddy Pig's sounds of nature. What? Come on, children, into the tent. It's bedtime.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸的大自然之声又来了。什么？来吧，孩子们，进帐篷去。该睡觉了。

lines.en: We won't all fit. The tent is too little. It will be fine. In you go! Move further in, Mummy Pig.
lines.zh: 我们装不下所有人。帐篷太小了。没问题的。进去吧！猪妈妈，再往里挪一点。

lines.en: Daddy, you're too big for the tent! Never mind, I'd rather sleep outside anyway. Good night, Daddy Pig! Good night, Daddy! Night night! Good night, everyone!
lines.zh: 爸爸，你太大了，帐篷装不下你！没关系，反正我更想睡在外面。晚安，猪爸爸！晚安，爸爸！晚安！大家晚安！

lines.en: Mummy Pig, Peppa and George are sleeping in the tent. Daddy Pig is sleeping outside under the stars.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈、佩奇和乔治睡在帐篷里。猪爸爸睡在外面，头顶是满天星星。

lines.en: I love camping: sleeping in the open air with the stars above me. Maybe this wasn't such a good idea after all.
lines.zh: 我喜欢露营：睡在露天里，头顶是满天星星。也许这终究不是个好主意。

lines.en: It is morning. Daddy, it was lovely and cozy in the tent. Oh, where's Daddy?
lines.zh: 天亮了。爸爸，帐篷里又暖和又舒服。哦，爸爸去哪儿了？

lines.en: Daddy Pig has gone. Poor Daddy Pig, he must have been cold and wet. And now where is he?
lines.zh: 猪爸爸不见了。可怜的猪爸爸，他一定又冷又湿。那他现在在哪儿呢？

lines.en: What's that sound? It sounds like snoring.
lines.zh: 那是什么声音？听起来像打呼噜。

lines.en: Daddy Pig! What? Daddy, you're safe! Of course I'm safe, I'm an expert at camping. I slept in the car!
lines.zh: 猪爸爸！什么？爸爸，你没事！我当然没事，我可是露营专家。我睡在车里啦！

lines.en: Silly Daddy! I love camping!
lines.zh: 傻爸爸！我喜欢露营！
